intro:
The evidence is hidden in the artwork.
Find the truth with a keen eye — a cyber sci-fi mystery!
description:
Step into a neon-soaked cyber city in this observation-based sci-fi mystery game.
You play as Miyabi, a sharp forensic investigator called to the scene of the crime.
Search each illustration for the clues hidden within — the key to cracking the case.

How to play is simple:
- Read the case briefing carefully
- Scan the scene for anything out of place — a strange detail, a telltale trace
- Once you spot it, move your cursor over it and press the A button

No expert knowledge required.
All you need is a sharp eye for detail and a flash of detective intuition.

Even an ordinary-looking scene might be hiding something off — if you look closely enough...
That rush of ""there it is!"" the moment you spot the clue? It's addictive.

Perfect for anyone who loves mysteries and puzzles,
or just can't resist a good spot-the-difference challenge.

Each case is a quick one-question round, making it perfect for a commute or a short break.
